ObjectName.value: Dark windows of the south tower - budapest (4168577612)

Categories.value: Mace Tower (Buda Castle)|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|Flickr files uploaded by Afifa Afrin

ImageDescription.value:
Hidden in a corner behind the palace, the Budapest History Museum (the Castle Museum) was a highlight of our visit. After wandering through the cavernous lowest level of the old palace you pop out at the courtyard gardens with a spectacular view of the city. Well, the city view is to the left not shown in this photo ... but still a pretty cool view.
